description: Three debaters (Claude Opus, Codex gpt-5.6-sol, opencode DeepSeek V4 Pro) argue for 2 rounds, with up to 1 extra round if the judge asks for one, then a Claude Opus judge decides. Caveat: the judge runs the same harness and model as debater 'opus'. A fresh process and a fresh session give session independence only -- NOT model independence: the judge shares Opus's priors, blind spots and stylistic preferences, so it may systematically favour that debater's plan. This IS the built-in default: heterogeneity across three harnesses is the mechanism the tool exists for. Use rosters/trio.json when you need a judge that is independent at the model level (Codex judges a Claude-vs-DeepSeek debate). Labels are deliberately anonymous ('Participant A/B/C') so no participant, and no judge, learns which model wrote which plan.
